MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Fourth Supplemental Request for Permission of Domestic Consumption of Precious Metals in the Second Quarter of 1948.
1. Reference is made to the following:
a. C.L.C.O. No. 61(LO 434 FI/2E), 4 February 1948, subject, "Fourth Supplemental Request for Permission of Domestic Consumption of Precious Metals in the Second Quarter of 1948."
b. Memorandum for the Japanese Government, file AG 410.2 (22 Nov 47)CPC/GP, SCAPIN 1825, 22 November 1947, subject, "Application for Use of Precious Metals for Domestic Consumption during the Period from Fourth Quarter of 1947 through Third Quarter of 1948," from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
2. Application for permission to use precious metal pigment, as requested by 1a above, is approved in the amounts and by the companies listed below. Mixed gold and silver pigment stocks from the pooled reserve under custody of the Ministry of Finance, Japanese Government, and released by reference 1b above, will be drawn upon to supply the precious metal pigment authorized.
